test: crates/engine/src/tests/robustness.rs: fixed_seeds_run_clean (seed 16, PR #704); contact case as crates/kernel/src/issue_674_tests.rs: partial_circular_contact_preserves_material_and_history (added in PR #782)
summary: Block 25 x 47.5 x 37.5 at the origin, joined with r 5, 2.5 long cylinders. Robustness seed 16 is a 4-copy circular pattern about Z of the cylinder based at (0,7.5,0) along +X, so half its end hangs below the bottom edge z=0. The runner has no pattern on union, so the copies are written out. Volumes are closed form: block plus the parts of each cylinder outside it. The copies do not overlap each other. Tolerance 0.01 mm^3, as the other analytic cases (SolidCraft's tests allow 0.1 and 0.2 for their mesh measure).

cases.name: partial_face_contact_back_to_back
cases.note: #674 contact, as issue_674_tests.rs: end on face x=0 from outside, half of it below z=0. Adds a whole cylinder.

cases.name: half_embedded_end_control
cases.note: Control: the 0 degree copy alone. Its end is on face x=0 and half of it lies inside the block, so only the half below z=0 adds material.

cases.name: seed_16_pattern
cases.note: Robustness seed 16 as a 4-copy circular pattern about Z. The 90 and 180 degree copies stay clear of the block and of each other, so 3 lumps.
